item.summary: fix(system-agent): show retryable error when AI detection times out (#121940) * fix(system-agent): reject empty detection timeouts instead of claiming nothing found * test(system-agent): give partial-timeout detection tests CI-safe deadlines The 50-100ms timeouts raced worker-thread startup on loaded CI runners: the partial message could miss the deadline, hitting the empty-timeout rejection and flaking two tests that expect a partial resolve. Timeouts that must be beaten by worker startup are now 3-5s; tight deadlines remain only where no worker message is required.
